paragraphs: Turning Point Brands, Inc. (the "Company," "we," "our," or "us") is a leading manufacturer, marketer and distributor of branded consumer products. We sell a wide range of products to adult consumers consisting of staple products with our iconic brands Zig-Zag® and Stoker's®. We primarily compete in the alternative smoking accessories and Other Tobacco Products ("OTP") industries, among other markets. The alternative smoking accessories market is a dynamic market experiencing robust secular growth driven by cannabinoid legalization in the U.S. and Canada, and positively evolving consumer perception and acceptance in North America. The OTP industry, which consists of non-cigarette tobacco products, exhibited steady consumer unit annualized volumes during the full year period ended 2025 as reported by Management Science Associates, Inc. ("MSAi") a third-party analytics and information company. Our segments are led by our core proprietary and iconic brands: Zig-Zag® in the Zig-Zag products segment, and Stoker's® along with FRE®, Beech-Nut® and Trophy® in the Stoker's products segment. Our businesses generate meaningful cash flow which we use to further invest in our business, introduce new product lines, finance acquisitions, increase brand support, expand our distribution infrastructure, and strengthen our capital position. We currently ship to approximately 900 distributors with an additional 600 secondary, indirect wholesalers in the U.S. that carry and sell our products. Under the leadership of a senior management team with extensive experience in the consumer products, alternative smoking accessories and tobacco industries, we have grown and diversified our business through new product launches, category expansions, and acquisitions while concurrently improving operational efficiency.

We believe there are meaningful opportunities to grow by investing in organic growth, acquisitions and joint ventures across all product categories. As of December 31, 2025, our products were available in approximately 220,000 retail locations in North America. Our sales team targets widespread distribution to all traditional retail channels, including convenience stores, and we have a growing e-commerce business.

On January 2, 2025, the Company contributed 100% of its interest in South Beach Brands LLC ("SBB"), the subsidiary that owned and operated the Company's former Creative Distribution Solutions ("CDS") reportable segment, to General Wireless Operations, Inc. ("GWO") in exchange for 49% of the issued and outstanding GWO common stock. GWO is majority owned by Standard General, LP.

The assets and liabilities associated with the CDS segment were classified as held for sale as of December 31, 2024, and its financial results were classified as discontinued operations and are reported separately for all periods presented herein until its disposition on January 2, 2025. With the classification of the CDS reportable segment to discontinued operations, the Company now has two reportable segments. Unless otherwise noted, the description of business in this Annual Report on Form 10-K relates solely to the continuing operations, comprised of the Zig-Zag and Stoker's segments.

In our Zig-Zag products ("Zig-Zag") segment, we principally market and distribute (i) rolling papers, tubes, and related products; (ii) finished cigars and make-your-own ("MYO") cigar wraps; and (iii) other accessories. In addition, we have a majority stake in 10233625 Canada Corp. ("Turning Point Brands Canada"), a specialty marketing and distribution firm focused on building brands in the Canadian cannabis accessories, tobacco and alternative products categories. The strength of the Zig-Zag® brand drives our leadership position in both the rolling papers and MYO cigar wrap markets. Zig-Zag® is the #1 premium and #1 overall rolling paper in the U.S. with approximately 33% total market share according to MSAi.1 Management estimates that Zig-Zag® is also the #1 brand in the Canadian market. Rolling paper operations are aided by our sourcing relationship with Republic Technology International SAS ("RTI"). See "Distribution and Supply Agreements" below for our discussion of the Zig-Zag® distribution agreement.

In MYO cigar wraps, the Zig-Zag® brand remains the market leader and continues to innovate in novel ways through additional product introductions. For instance, we introduced Zig-Zag® ‘Rillo sized wraps, which are similar in size to cigarillos, the most popular and fastest growing type of machine-made cigars. In June 2020, we purchased certain assets from our long-term commercial partner Durfort Holdings S.R.L (‘‘Durfort'') which included the co-ownership in the intellectual property rights for all of our MYO Homogenized Tobacco Leaf ("HTL") cigar wraps products. In late 2021, we extended our MYO cigar wraps offering with entries into the growing hemp wraps and natural leaf wraps markets.

In July 2019, to extend our reach in Canada, we made a minority investment in Turning Point Brands Canada that we increased to a 65% ownership stake by July 2021. Our majority ownership stake leverages Turning Point Brands Canada's significant expertise in marketing and distributing cannabis accessories and tobacco products throughout Canada. The remainder of Turning Point Brands Canada is owned by its management.
1 Brand ranking and market share percentages obtained from MSAi for the 52-week period ended December 27, 2025.

In July 2021, we acquired certain assets of Unitabac, LLC ("Unitabac"), a marketer of mass-market cigars. In the acquisition, we acquired a robust portfolio of cigarillo products and all related intellectual property, including Cigarillo Non-Tip (NT) HTL products and Rolled Leaf and Natural Leaf Cigarillo products that we are using to re-introduce the Zig-Zag® brand into a large and growing cigarillo market.
We have continued to reposition this segment with growth initiatives focused on new product introductions and new channel expansions that are better aligned with the growing market trends.

In our Stoker's products ("Stoker's") segment, we (i) manufacture and market moist snuff tobacco ("MST"), (ii) contract for and market FRE® and ALP®, our modern oral products, and (iii) contract for and market loose-leaf chewing tobacco products. Stoker's® is our focus brand in both MST and chewing tobacco. In MST, Stoker's® remains among the fastest growing brands and holds a 12.4% share in the stores that carry our products and a 8.1% share of the total U.S. MST non-pouch market. Stoker's® is a pioneer in the MST industry.1 It was first to introduce the large 12 oz. tub packaging format and is manufactured using a proprietary process that we believe results in a superior product. Starting in 2015, we extended the Stoker's® MST franchise to include traditional 12oz. cans to broaden retail availability. Our proprietary manufacturing process is conducted at our Dresden, Tennessee plant and packaged in both our Dresden, Tennessee, and Louisville, Kentucky, facilities.

Stoker's® chewing tobacco has grown its market share considerably over the last several years becoming the largest brand family in the industry and is presently the #1 discount and #1 overall brand in the industry, with approximately a 34.1% market share.1 Our status in the chewing tobacco market is further strengthened by Beech-Nut®, the #3 premium brand and #7 overall, as well as Trophy®, Durango® and the five Wind River Brands. Collectively, the Company is the #1 marketer of chewing tobacco with approximately 38.0% market share.1 Our chewing tobacco operations are facilitated through our long-standing relationship with Swedish Match (a division of Philip Morris International Inc.), the manufacturer of our loose-leaf chewing tobaccos.

In September 2024, one of the Company's wholly-owned subsidiaries acquired a 50% stake in ALP Supply Co., LLC ("ALP"). ALP is a joint venture established with Last Country Ventures, LLC for the purpose of selling and distributing tobacco-free white pouch nicotine products in 3, 6 and 9 mg strengths. In 2026, ALP intends to broaden its portfolio, including with the introduction of 12 mg strength. Pursuant to the joint venture agreement, the Company's subsidiary is responsible for selling products to ALP and providing warehousing and shipping services on its behalf.

General Risks
Sales of tobacco products are generally expected to continue to decline.
We depend on a small number of key third-party suppliers and producers for our products.
We may be unable to identify or contract with new suppliers or producers in the event of a disruption to our supply of products.
Our licenses to use certain brands and trademarks may be terminated or not renewed.
We may not be successful in maintaining the consumer brand recognition and consumer loyalty to our products or in anticipating and responding to changes in consumer preferences and purchase behavior.
Our distribution efforts rely in part on our ability to leverage relationships with large retailers and national chains.
We face intense competition and may fail to compete effectively.
Competition from illicit sources may have an adverse effect on our overall sales volume, restricting the ability to increase selling prices and damaging brand equity.
Contamination of, or damage to, our products could adversely impact sales volume, market share and profitability.
The market for certain of our products is subject to a great deal of uncertainty and is still evolving.
We could decide, or be required to, recall products, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, reputation, financial position, results of operations, or cash flows.
We may encounter difficulties or liabilities arising from investments in businesses.
We are subject to substantial and increasing regulation.
Our products are regulated by the FDA, which has broad regulatory powers.
Many of our products contain nicotine, which is considered to be a highly addictive substance.
We are required to maintain cash amounts within an escrow account in order to be compliant with a settlement agreement between us and certain U.S. states and territories.
Increases in tobacco-related taxes have been proposed or enacted and are likely to continue to be proposed or enacted in numerous jurisdictions.
paragraphs: The risk factors summarized and detailed below could materially harm our business, operating results and/or financial condition, impair our future prospects and/or cause the price of our common stock to decline. These are not all of the risks we face and other factors not presently known to us or that we currently believe are immaterial may also affect our business if they occur. Material risks that may affect our business, operating results and financial condition include, but are not necessarily limited to, those relating to:
declining sales of tobacco products and expected continuing decline of sales in the tobacco industry overall;
our dependence on a small number of third-party suppliers and producers;

the possibility that we will be unable to identify or contract with new suppliers or producers in the event of a supply or product disruption, as well as other supply chain concerns, including delays in product shipments and increases in freight cost;

paragraphs: Turning Point Brands, Inc. (the "Company," "we," "our," or "us") 為一領導品牌消費者產品的製造、行銷與經銷公司。我們銷售多樣化產品給成人消費者，包含我們標誌性品牌 Zig-Zag® 和 Stoker's® 的基本用品。我們主要在替代性吸煙配件與其他煙草產品 ("OTP") 行業等市場競爭。替代性吸煙配件市場為一動態市場，經歷強勁的長期成長，因美國與加拿大大麻合法化，以及北美地區消費者觀念與接受度的正面演進。OTP 行業，包含非香煙煙草產品，根據 Management Science Associates, Inc. ("MSAi") 一間第三方分析與資訊公司所報導，在 2025 年度全年期間，消費者單位年化銷售量表現穩定。我們的應報告分部由我們核心專屬與標誌性品牌領導：Zig-Zag® 在 Zig-Zag 產品分部，以及 Stoker's® 配合 FRE®、Beech-Nut® 和 Trophy® 在 Stoker's 產品分部。我們的業務產生顯著現金流，我們用來進一步投資業務、推出新產品線、資金融資收購、增加品牌支援、擴展經銷基礎設施，以及強化資本結構。我們目前經銷至約 900 家經銷商，並有額外 600 家次級間接經銷商在美國，銷售我們的產品。在具備豐富消費者產品、替代性吸煙配件與煙草產業經驗的高階管理團隊領導下，我們透過新產品發佈、類別擴張與收購，同時提高運營效率，來成長與多元化我們的業務。
我們相信透過在所有產品類別投資於內生成長、收購與合資企業，有顯著成長機會。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的產品在北美約有 220,000 個零售點。我們的銷售團隊目標為廣泛經銷至所有傳統零售通路，包括便利商店，我們的電商業務正在成長。

2025 年 1 月 2 日，本公司將其 100% 持有 South Beach Brands LLC ("SBB")，該子公司擁有並營運本公司前 Creative Distribution Solutions ("CDS") 應報告分部，轉讓給 General Wireless Operations, Inc. ("GWO")，以換取 GWO 發行在外普通股的 49%。GWO 由 Standard General, LP 多數持有。
與 CDS 分部相關的資產與負債於 2024 年 12 月 31 日被歸類為待售，其財務結果被歸類為已終止營運，並在本文件中所有期間內分開報告，直到 2025 年 1 月 2 日處置為止。隨著 CDS 應報告分部被歸類為已終止營運，本公司現在有兩個應報告分部。除非另有說明，本 10-K 年度報告中對業務的描述僅針對持續營運，包含 Zig-Zag 與 Stoker's 分部。

在 Zig-Zag 產品 ("Zig-Zag") 分部，我們主要行銷與經銷 (i) 卷煙紙、筒與相關產品；(ii) 成品雪茄與自製 ("MYO") 雪茄包覆紙；以及 (iii) 其他配件。此外，我們在 10233625 Canada Corp. ("Turning Point Brands Canada") 持有大多數股權，這是一家專門從事加拿大大麻配件、煙草與替代產品品牌建設的行銷與經銷公司。Zig-Zag® 品牌的強大，驅動我們在卷煙紙與 MYO 雪茄包覆紙市場的領導地位。Zig-Zag® 為美國 #1 高端與 #1 總體卷煙紙，根據 MSAi，市場佔有率約為 33%。管理層估計 Zig-Zag® 也是加拿大市場的 #1 品牌。卷煙紙業務受益於我們與 Republic Technology International SAS ("RTI") 的採購關係。請參閱 "經銷與供應契約" 下方對 Zig-Zag® 經銷契約的討論。

在 MYO 雪茄包覆紙市場，Zig-Zag® 品牌仍為市場領導者，並持續透過新產品發佈創新。例如，我們發佈了 Zig-Zag® ‘Rillo 尺寸包覆紙，與雪茄illos 相似，為最流行且成長最快的機械製雪茄類型。2020 年 6 月，我們從長期商業夥伴 Durfort Holdings S.R.L (‘‘Durfort'') 購買了部分資產，包含我們 MYO 同質化煙葉 ("HTL") 雪茄包覆紙產品的智慧財產權共有人權。2021 年底，我們擴展 MYO 雪茄包覆紙產品線，進駐成長中的大麻包覆紙與天然葉包覆紙市場。
2019 年 7 月，為擴展加拿大市場，我們對 Turning Point Brands Canada 進行少數投資，並於 2021 年 7 月提高至 65% 的股權。我們的大多數股權利用 Turning Point Brands Canada 在加拿大行銷與經銷大麻配件與煙草產品的專業知識。Turning Point Brands Canada 剩餘部分由其管理層擁有。
1 品牌排名與市場佔有率百分比來自 MSAi，為 2025 年 12 月 27 日結束的 52 週期間。

2021年7月，本公司取得Unitabac, LLC（"Unitabac"）的部分資產，Unitabac為大眾市場雪茄的行銷商。在此次收購中，本公司取得一項強大的雪茄棒產品組合及所有相關智慧財產權，包括Cigarillo Non-Tip (NT) HTL產品及Rolled Leaf和Natural Leaf Cigarillo產品，我們正利用這些產品重新推出Zig-Zag®品牌進佔一個龐大且成長中的雪茄棒市場。
本公司持續重新定位此應報告分部，透過聚焦於新產品推出與新通路擴張的成長策略，使業務更符合成長中的市場趨勢。

在Stoker's產品（"Stoker's"）應報告分部，本公司（i）製造與行銷濕式嚼煙（"MST"），（ii）委託製造並行銷FRE®與ALP®，本公司現代口香產品，以及（iii）委託製造並行銷散葉嚼煙產品。Stoker's®為本公司在MST與嚼煙產品中的重點品牌。在MST市場，Stoker's®仍為成長最快的品牌之一，並在銷售本公司產品的商店中佔有12.4%的市佔率，同時在美國MST非包裝市場中佔有8.1%的市佔率。Stoker's®為MST產業的先驅者。1 本公司為首個推出12盎司管裝包裝格式的廠商，並使用專利製程製造，我們認為此製程可產生更優質的產品。自2015年起，本公司將Stoker's® MST品牌延伸至傳統12盎司罐裝，以擴大零售可得性。本公司專利製程於德薩克斯，田納西州工廠進行，並在德薩克斯，田納西州與路易維爾，肯塔基州的廠區進行包裝。

Stoker's®嚼煙產品在過去數年中大幅成長其市佔率，成為產業中最大的品牌家族，目前為產業中排名第一的折扣品牌與總體排名第一的品牌，市佔率約為34.1%。1 本公司在嚼煙市場的優勢進一步強化，因有Beech-Nut®，為第三大高階品牌與第七大總體品牌，以及Trophy®、Durango®與五個Wind River品牌。 collectively，本公司為嚼煙產品的首大行銷商，市佔率約為38.0%。1 本公司嚼煙業務透過與瑞典-match（為菲莫國際股份有限公司的子公司）長久的合作關係進行，瑞典-match為本公司散葉嚼煙產品的製造商。

2024年9月，本公司之一家全資子公司取得ALP Supply Co., LLC（"ALP"）50%的股權。ALP為與Last Country Ventures, LLC共同成立的合資公司，主要業務為銷售與分銷無煙白包尼古丁產品，產品有3、6與9毫克強度。2026年，ALP預計將擴大其產品組合，包括推出12毫克強度的產品。根據合資協議，本公司子公司負責向ALP銷售產品，並代表ALP提供倉儲與運輸服務。
本公司認為本公司競爭優勢包括以下項目：大型領導品牌，具有顯著規模

headings: 與本公司及產業相關之風險
與法律、稅務及監管事項相關之風險
與財務結果、財務狀況及資本結構相關之風險
與本公司普通股相關之風險
一般風險
煙草產品之銷售通常預期將持續下降。
本公司產品依賴少數關鍵第三方供應商及製造商。
若產品供應遭中斷，本公司可能無法識別或與新供應商或製造商簽訂契約。
本公司使用特定品牌及商標的授權可能終止或不續約。
本公司可能無法成功維持消費者對產品的品牌認知及忠誠度，或預測並回應消費者偏好及購買新行為的變化。
本公司銷售努力部分依賴於本公司利用與大型零售通路及全國連鎖店的關係。
本公司面臨激烈競爭，可能無法有效競爭。
非法來源的競爭可能對本公司總銷售量產生不利影響，限制提高售價的能力，並損害品牌價值。
本公司產品受汙染或受損，可能對銷售量、市場佔有率及利潤率產生不利影響。
本公司部分產品的市場面臨極大的不確定性，且仍在發展中。
本公司可能決定，或被要求召回產品，這可能對本公司業務、聲譽、財務狀況、營運成果或現金流產生重大不利影響。
我們可能面臨因投資於企業而產生的困難或負債。
我們受到大量且持續增加的規範管制。
我們的產品受到美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）的管制，該機構擁有廣泛的監管權力。
我們許多產品含有尼古丁，而尼古丁被認為是一種高度成癮的物質。
我們必須維持一定現金金額於託管帳戶內，以符合我們與某些美國州及屬地之間和解協議的規定。
已提出或實施了多項與煙草相關的稅收增加措施，且預期將在許多司法管轄區持續提出或實施。
paragraphs: 下列所歸納及詳細說明的風險因素，可能會重大影響本公司業務、營運成果及/或財務狀況，影響本公司未來展望及/或導致本公司普通股價格下跌。這些並非本公司所面臨的全部風險，且其他尚未為本公司所知或目前認為不具重大影響的因素，若發生亦可能影響本公司業務。
煙草產品銷售減少，以及煙草產業整體銷售持續減少的預期；
本公司對少數第三方供應商及製造商的依賴；
本公司可能無法在供應或產品中斷的情況下識別或與新供應商或製造商簽訂契約，以及其它供應鏈相關問題，包括產品出貨延遲及運費成本增加；
本公司使用特定品牌或商標的授權可能被終止、質疑或受到限制；
未能維持消費者對本公司產品的品牌認知及忠誠度，以及未能預見及回應消費者偏好及購買新行為的改變；
